item.title: The Witcher 3 expansion rumours refuse to go away: originating analyst is "100% certain CD Projekt Red will release significant new content this year"
item.description: The analyst who forecasted a Witcher 3 expansion release in 2026 has told me they're "100 percent certain [CD Projekt Red] will release significant new content this year". Read more

item.title: Netflix confirms The Witcher series will end this year
item.description: Netflix has today confirmed that the fifth and final season of The Witcher will air on the streaming service this year. It follows Season 4 in rapid succession - that series having launched at the end of October last year. Read more

item.title: A mysterious new Life is Strange game has just been rated in Europe
item.description: A new Life is Strange game, titled Life is Strange: Reunion, has been rated in Europe. Since being discovered by fans, the game's presence on the PEGI website has since been removed. Read more

item.title: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora sees a boost in players after Avatar: Fire and Ash's box office domination, and the addition of a surprisingly decent DLC drop and update
item.description: The world has gone blue once again. James Cameron's Avatar: Fire and Ash is torching the box office, having already passed the $1 billion global mark and probably kickstarting serious conversations about Avatar 4 and 5 (both are written but waiting for the green light). And it looks like 2023's Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora is also benefitting from some brand synergy. Read more

item.title: Netease pirate RPG Sea of Remnants gets a new gameplay trailer, showcasing drink-offs, Mahjong, and ocean combat
item.description: Netease has finally released a gameplay trailer for its pirate Adventure RPG Sea of Remnants, which showcases a variety of features including ship combat, open area exploration, drinking competitions, and Mahjong. Read more

item.title: "We reiterate our firm belief that Rockstar broke the law" - union and GTA 6 maker clash again around preliminary hearing for fired workers
item.description: The Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB) and Rockstar Games have traded more blows following a preliminary tribunal hearing this week. There, the IWGB asked a judge to grant the fired Grand Theft Auto 6 developers interim relief. Read more

item.title: Nintendo's got two new Joy-Con 2 colours for Switch 2, and they're due next month
item.description: Nintendo has announced two pastelly new Joy-Con 2 controller colours for Switch 2, and said they'll release next month. Read more

item.title: Xbox is hosting a Developer Direct later this month, featuring Fable, Forza, and more
item.description: Microsoft has announced another Developer Direct, set to take place on the 22nd January. It'll feature Fable, Forza, and Beast of Reincarnation. Read more

item.title: Phasmophobia studio Kinetic moves into indie publishing but is otherwise entirely focused on horror game's impending 1.0 release
item.description: Phasmophobia studio Kinetic Games is branching out into indie game publishing, and is actively seeking "creative games from small teams and solo developers globally, who have a clear vision for their title and are 12-18 months from release", a press release said. Read more

item.title: 2026's rumoured Witcher 3 expansion will take us further afield than ever before, per new rumours
item.description: It's been a busy year so far for a game that's over 10 years old. If you've not been following, last week, we asked "is there really going to be a new Witcher 3 expansion this year?", responding to comments from Borys Nie&sacutepielak, a trusted source of Polish games industry information. Following his remarks, a Noble Securities analyst then added fuel to the fire this week. Read more
